crossRefs.note: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to…
I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
I will grant you mercy, that he may have mercy on you, and cause you to return to your own land.

translations.web: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.
translations.bsb: Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.
translations.kjv: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.
translations.asv: Show us thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, And grant us thy salvation.
